shortDescription: Configures vNIC templates on Cisco UCS Manager

options.name: cdn_name
options.description: CDN Name used when cdn_source is set to user-defined.

options.name: cdn_source
options.description: CDN Source field. This can be one of the following options: vnic-name - Uses the vNIC template name of the vNIC instance as the CDN name. This is the default option. user-defined - Uses a user-defined CDN name for the vNIC template. If this option is chosen, cdn_name must also be provided.

options.name: description
options.description: A user-defined description of the vNIC template. Enter up to 256 characters. You can use any characters or spaces except the following: ` (accent mark),  (backslash), ^ (carat), " (double quote), = (equal sign), > (greater than), < (less than), or ' (single quote).

options.name: fabric
options.description: The Fabric ID field specifying the fabric interconnect associated with vNICs created from this template. If you want fabric failover enabled on vNICs created from this template, use of of the following:" A-B to use Fabric A by default with failover enabled. B-A to use Fabric B by default with failover enabled. Do not enable vNIC fabric failover under the following circumstances: - If the Cisco UCS domain is running in Ethernet switch mode. vNIC fabric failover is not supported in that mode. - If

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP address or hostname of Cisco UCS Manager. Modules can be used with the UCS Platform Emulator U(https://cs.co/ucspe)

options.name: mac_pool
options.description: The MAC address pool that vNICs created from this vNIC template should use.

options.name: mtu
options.description: The MTU field. The maximum transmission unit, or packet size, that vNICs created from this vNIC template should use. Enter a string between '1500' and '9000'. If the vNIC template has an associated QoS policy, the MTU specified here must be equal to or less than the MTU specified in the QoS system class.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the vNIC template. This name can be between 1 and 16 alphanumeric characters. You cannot use spaces or any special characters other than - (hyphen), "_" (underscore), : (colon), and . (period). You cannot change this name after the template is created.

options.name: network_control_policy
options.description: The network control policy that vNICs created from this vNIC template should use.

options.name: org_dn
options.description: Org dn (distinguished name)

options.name: password
options.description: Password for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.

options.name: peer_redundancy_template
options.description: The Peer Redundancy Template. The name of the vNIC template sharing a configuration with this template. If the redundancy_type is primary, the name of the secondary template should be provided. If the redundancy_type is secondary, the name of the primary template should be provided. Secondary templates can only configure non-shared properties (name, description, and mac_pool).

options.name: pin_group
options.description: The LAN pin group that vNICs created from this vNIC template should use.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used during connection (by default uses 443 for https and 80 for http connection).

options.name: proxy
options.description: If use_proxy is no, specfies proxy to be used for connection. e.g. 'http://proxy.xy.z:8080'

options.name: qos_policy
options.description: The quality of service (QoS) policy that vNICs created from this vNIC template should use.

options.name: redundancy_type
options.description: The Redundancy Type used for vNIC redundancy pairs during fabric failover. This can be one of the following: primary — Creates configurations that can be shared with the Secondary template. secondary — All shared configurations are inherited from the Primary template. none - Legacy vNIC template behavior. Select this option if you do not want to use redundancy.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), will verify vNIC templates are present and will create if needed. If C(absent), will verify vNIC templates are absent and will delete if needed.

options.name: stats_policy
options.description: The statistics collection policy that vNICs created from this vNIC template should use.

options.name: target
options.description: The possible target for vNICs created from this template. The target determines whether or not Cisco UCS Manager automatically creates a VM-FEX port profile with the appropriate settings for the vNIC template. This can be one of the following: adapter — The vNICs apply to all adapters. No VM-FEX port profile is created if you choose this option. vm - The vNICs apply to all virtual machines. A VM-FEX port profile is created if you choose this option.

options.name: template_type
options.description: The Template Type field. This can be one of the following: initial-template — vNICs created from this template are not updated if the template changes. updating-template - vNICs created from this template are updated if the template changes.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), will not use the proxy as defined by system environment variable.

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If C(no), an HTTP connection will be used instead of the default HTTPS connection.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for Cisco UCS Manager authentication.

options.name: vlans_list
options.description: List of VLANs used by the vNIC template.
